name: @buoy/workspace
description: Buoy — a durable remote terminal (ssh + tmux) whose sessions resurface after network drops

scripts.build:frontend: npm run typecheck:ui && npm run build:frontend -w @buoy/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:ui && npm run typecheck:test && npm run typecheck:ui-test
scripts.test:ui:build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:ui-test && cross-env TAURI_CONFIG={\"build\":{\"devUrl\":null}} cargo build -p buoy --features ui-test
scripts.test:ui:build:mobile: npm run typecheck && npm run build:frontend -w @buoy/mobile && npm run build:ui-test && cross-env "TAURI_CONFIG={\"build\":{\"devUrl\":null,\"frontendDist\":\"../../mobile/dist\"}}" cargo build -p buoy --features ui-test
scripts.test:ui:desktop: npm run test:ui:build && wdio run wdio.conf.ts
scripts.test:ui: npm run test:ui:desktop && npm run gui-mobile-shell
scripts.gui-rename: npm run test:ui:build && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec test/gui-rename.ts
scripts.gui-reorder: npm run test:ui:build && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec test/gui-reorder.ts
scripts.gui-notifications: npm run test:ui:build && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec test/gui-notifications.ts
scripts.gui-new-session: npm run test:ui:build && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec test/gui-new-session.ts
scripts.gui-terminal-repaint: npm run test:ui:build && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec test/gui-terminal-repaint.ts
scripts.gui-session-history: npm run test:ui:build && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec test/gui-session-history.ts
scripts.screenshots:readme: npm run test:ui:build && cross-env BUOY_README_SCREENSHOT_DIR=docs/screenshots wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec test/gui-readme-screenshots.ts
scripts.gui-mobile-shell: npm run test:ui:build:mobile && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec test/gui-mobile-shell.ts
scripts.measure:renderer: npm run test:ui:build && cross-env BUOY_RENDERER_BENCHMARK_BACKEND=canvas wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec test/gui-renderer-benchmark.ts && cross-env BUOY_RENDERER_BENCHMARK_BACKEND=dom wdio run wdio.conf.ts --spec test/gui-renderer-benchmark.ts
scripts.mobile:check: npm run typecheck && npm run build:frontend -w @buoy/mobile && cargo check -p buoy-mobile

//devDependencies: The GUI suites use WebdriverIO's embedded Tauri WebDriver to exercise the real platform webview; the ui-test Cargo feature is excluded from production builds.
